# Kingdom Impact Ventures

> Kingdom Impact Ventures (KIV) builds practical technology ventures for KCAN
> (Kingdom Citizens & Ambassadors Network), beginning with Kingdom Impact
> Social (KIS) and extending into future education, market, payments and
> health products. KIV is the business and technology venture arm of KCAN;
> KIS is its first flagship product.

Public claims on this site are stage-aware: features and ventures are
described as live, in advanced launch preparation, planned, or
research-stage, and availability (Android/iOS/web) is only claimed where a
real, configured link exists.

## Company

- [About](https://kingdomimpactventures.org/about): Who KIV is, how it operates, and how it answers to KCAN.
- [Mission](https://kingdomimpactventures.org/mission): The mission and operating principles behind every KIV product decision.
- [Who We Serve](https://kingdomimpactventures.org/who-we-serve): The people KIS is built for, the real problems they face, and how KIS solves them.
- [Trust](https://kingdomimpactventures.org/trust): Trust, safety and public-claims policy.
- [Security](https://kingdomimpactventures.org/security): Security practices and how to report a vulnerability.
- [Updates](https://kingdomimpactventures.org/updates): Public updates on KIS launch preparation and the wider venture portfolio.

## Products

- [Products overview](https://kingdomimpactventures.org/products): KIS, the flagship app, plus the staged KIE/KIM/KIP/KIH venture portfolio.
- [KIS - Kingdom Impact Social](https://kingdomimpactventures.org/products/kis): The first flagship product - social, partner and discipleship platform for KCAN communities. Advanced launch preparation.
- [KIE](https://kingdomimpactventures.org/products/kie): Planned/research-stage education venture.
- [KIM](https://kingdomimpactventures.org/products/kim): Planned/research-stage market venture.
- [KIP](https://kingdomimpactventures.org/products/kip): Planned/research-stage payments venture.
- [KIH](https://kingdomimpactventures.org/products/kih): Planned/research-stage health-support venture.
- [KISTube](https://kistube.kingdomimpactventures.org): Video platform inside the KIS ecosystem, on its own subdomain.
- [Download](https://kingdomimpactventures.org/download): Current KIS availability by platform.

## Working with KIV

- [Partners](https://kingdomimpactventures.org/partners): How churches, ministries and organisations can partner with KIV and KIS.
- [Investors](https://kingdomimpactventures.org/investors): Investor information, without unsupported claims.
- [Contact](https://kingdomimpactventures.org/contact): The right way to reach KIV - support, partners, investors and security.
- [Support](https://kingdomimpactventures.org/support): Support articles on contact, account/data requests and availability.
